name: Sendenhorst (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, red and yellow in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Sendenhorst (Saint Martin on horseback with a beggar on yellow).
history: The arms were granted on 5 September 1979 together with the hoisted flag, described as yellow, red and yellow striped 1:3:1 with the city shield in the middle of the red stripe.

features.role: Sendenhorst arms — Saint Martin on yellow
